items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The first recording under your name, La Perfecta, featuring your tunes, primarily your tunes... Yeah, about 8 of them.

ctx.x: You’re obviously very prolific, because I looked down at your discography, and there are so many great titles that have impacted not only what we call Latin music or Afro-Caribbean music, but has gone on to influence music around the world. The first recording under your name, La Perfecta, featuring your tunes, primarily your tunes...
